title: alternanthera maritima var. sparmannii
intro: Alternanthera maritima var. sparmannii, commonly known as the 'Sea Kalanchoe' or 'Coral Kalanchoe', is a succulent plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health issues such as fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions due to its antipyretic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Alternanthera maritima var. sparmannii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which possess therapeutic actions like antioxidant, analgesic, and antiseptic properties. Regular consumption of this plant has been associated with improved immune function, reduced inflammation, and enhanced wound healing capabilities.
